'''Kal Braggan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Police officer/Legends|member]] of [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]], later turned criminal, who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]

==Biography==
{{Quote|I really had not meant to hurt him. Just scare him off. But things got out of hand, and I panicked. I must have dropped my medal during the chaos that ensued. Oh my. It would seem that this medal is my undoing. How appropriate.|Lieutenant Colonel Quelsh, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />}}
Kal Braggan was CorSec officer several years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. At some point, he was framed by his fellow officer, [[Wilfred Quelsh]], of taking money from [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] in return for looking the other way as they brought illegal goods to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. As a result, Quelsh received the [[Corellian Medal of Honor]] and Braggan was convicted, discharged and sent to prison for a number of years. When Braggan came out of prison, he formed the criminal organization, [[Braggan's Fist]].<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Kal Braggan had gathered evidence of his innocence and confronted [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] Wilfred Quelsh. However, Quelsh panicked killed Braggan and lost his Corellian Medal of Honor near the body. CorSec [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Alana Walden|Walden]] later tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to recover the missing medal. The spacer discovered the location of the [[Braggan's Fist Camp]] and he found the medal next to Braggan's body. He also found Braggan's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], which had on it proof that Braggan had been framed. Major Walden eventually arrested Wilfred Quelsh for his crimes.<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Kal_Braggan_corpse.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Kal Braggan's corpse in ''Star Wars Galaxies'']]
Kal Braggan appeared as a corpse in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kal Braggan was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref> Due to limited game mechanics, Kal Braggan appeared as a skeleton in the game although he had just been killed.<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />
